name: JW Marriott Orlando Bonnet Creek
positioning: JW Marriott Orlando Bonnet Creek Resort & Spa, a Walt Disney World Gateway Hotel by Bonnet Creek Preserve with family suites, a kids club and Spa by JW
best_for: Families visiting Walt Disney World and Disney Springs
Guests who want a spa and pool days between park visits

facts.text: The resort is a Walt Disney World Gateway Hotel, offering convenient access to Walt Disney World Resort and Disney Springs.
Rooms look out over Bonnet Creek Preserve and the surrounding Disney parks.
Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows that overlook the resort's two pools and can offer a glimpse of Epcot's nightly fireworks.
Spa by JW is a day spa with treatment rooms and express pods.
A full-service beauty salon sits next to Spa by JW.
Guests can reserve a private poolside cabana or daybed with a personal attendant and a seasonal fruit plate.
Daily wellness classes, from yoga to HIIT, are held at Motion Studio on the 3rd floor.
Hidden Garden Kids Club offers supervised themed daily adventures for children aged 5 to 12.
Guests can write letters to the fairies and pick up a fairy mail reply, covered in fairy dust, at the front desk.
The garden's signature rosemary features in dishes at Sear + Sea Woodfire Grill and in cocktails at UnReserved and Sear + Sea Lobby Bar.

highlights.text: Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows that overlook the resort's two pools and can offer a glimpse of Epcot's nightly fireworks.
A Fairy Door Scavenger Hunt hides little fairy doors throughout the hotel and the surrounding Bonnet Creek preserve.
Family loft suites have kid-friendly loft beds and ample space to play.
Family activities include the Mount Chelonia rock-climbing wall, rooftop garden golf and a kids and teen activity center on the 6th floor.
The JW Garden is an herb and citrus filled garden with lush greens and local pollinators.

considerations.text: Hidden Garden Kids Club requires reservations.
The rock wall and garden golf require reservations, and age and weight rules apply.
A daily resort fee applies, and its rate and inclusions are subject to change.
